# validkit

> Typed newtypes for validated domain primitives: parse-once, use-everywhere
> strong types for emails, URLs, cron expressions, tenant slugs, locale tags,
> flag names, S3 bucket names, object keys, and E.164 phones. Each type
> guarantees its invariants at construction time, replacing hand-rolled
> `is_valid_*` checks.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): validation semantics, type catalog, usage.
- [REQUIREMENTS.md](REQUIREMENTS.md): numbered requirements REQ-VK-001..204 with test traceability.
- [THREAT-MODEL.md](THREAT-MODEL.md): threat model and security mitigations.
- [COVERAGE-NOTES.md](COVERAGE-NOTES.md): coverage notes and exclusions.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): security policy.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): release history.
